question: Should OpenClaw expand the official `memory-lancedb` plugin with opt-in hybrid retrieval, or make the active community plugin the supported path for this advanced capability?
rationale: Both outcomes fit the plugin architecture: LanceDB 0.30.0 supports a clean implementation, while VISION.md sets a high bar for expanding optional official plugins and an active community implementation already exists. Repository intent must determine the permanent owner and defaults.

options.title: Sponsor official parity
options.body: Implement opt-in hybrid retrieval in the official plugin with vector-only compatibility, existing-table index handling, and real LanceDB proof.

options.title: Use community plugin
options.body: Keep the official plugin intentionally minimal and close this request with a self-serve ClawHub handoff to the maintained enhanced LanceDB plugin.

recommendation.title: Sponsor official parity
recommendation.body: Implement opt-in hybrid retrieval in the official plugin with vector-only compatibility, existing-table index handling, and real LanceDB proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current plugin-history signal and authored the recent issue-specific direction that kept official parity under consideration.
